cases.cause: PR-DC replays S2/S3 without incrementing turn_counter, so the contract id is sha1(turn_index|player text) at the session's initial counter. PR-DD increments turn_counter after each prior turn, which changes turn_index and therefore the contract id. Those identifiers have equal length, so the byte count matches and the hash does not. The builder stamps pr-db and pr-dd are not present in the serialized provider payload.
